"""Bounded question orchestration and deterministic evidence/calculation checks."""
import math
from time import monotonic

from .provider import ProviderError
from .schemas import Answer, DraftAnswer, Usage
from .highlights import validated_highlights, whole_model_count_kind
from .source_context import IFC_CONTEXT_PROPERTIES


def validate_draft(draft: DraftAnswer, document, gate, *, server_catalog_count=False):
    allowed_pages = {p.number for p in document.pages}
    if any(item.page not in allowed_pages for item in draft.evidence):
        raise ProviderError("The model returned a reference to an uninspected page. Please try a more specific question.")
    if draft.model_evidence:
        if document.kind != "ifc" or not document.scene or document.scene.derived:
            raise ProviderError("The model cited IFC evidence for a drawing. Please retry.")
        elements = {e.id: e for e in document.scene.elements}
        for ref in draft.model_evidence:
            if ref.element_id is None:
                if not server_catalog_count or not document.scene.catalog_complete or ref.property_name:
                    raise ProviderError("Catalog-only evidence is reserved for a server-computed zero count.")
            elif ref.element_id not in elements:
                raise ProviderError("The model cited an unknown IFC element.")
            elif ref.property_name and ref.property_name not in {p.name for p in elements[ref.element_id].properties[:IFC_CONTEXT_PROPERTIES]}:
                raise ProviderError("The model cited an unavailable IFC property.")
    if gate.decision != "sufficient" and draft.status != gate.decision:
        raise ProviderError("The model returned an answer inconsistent with the evidence assessment. Please retry or clarify the question.")
    if draft.status == "answered" and not (draft.evidence or draft.model_evidence):
        raise ProviderError("The model did not provide supporting source regions. Please try a more specific question.")
    if draft.proposal and draft.proposal.basis != "explicit_assumption":
        raise ProviderError("The model proposed an unverified reference building. Please retry without a comparison request.")
    if draft.proposal and draft.proposal.reference:
        raise ProviderError("The model returned an unsupported proposal reference. Please retry.")
    if draft.calculation:
        if draft.status != "answered" or "{result}" not in draft.answer:
            raise ProviderError("The model returned an incomplete calculation. Please rephrase the measurement question.")
        calculation = draft.calculation
        if any(v.evidence_index >= len(draft.evidence or draft.model_evidence) for v in calculation.operands):
            raise ProviderError("A calculation input lacks a source reference. Please provide clearer dimensions.")
        values = [v.value for v in calculation.operands]
        if calculation.operation == "sum":
            result = sum(values)
        elif calculation.operation == "product":
            result = math.prod(values)
        elif len(values) != 2:
            raise ProviderError("The model returned an invalid two-input calculation. Please retry.")
        elif calculation.operation == "difference":
            result = values[0] - values[1]
        elif values[1] == 0:
            raise ProviderError("The model returned a division by zero. Please provide clearer dimensions.")
        else:
            result = values[0] / values[1]
        if not math.isfinite(result):
            raise ProviderError("The model returned an invalid numerical calculation. Please retry.")
        draft.answer = draft.answer.replace("{result}", f"{result:.6g}")
    elif "{result}" in draft.answer:
        raise ProviderError("The model omitted the calculation inputs. Please retry.")
    draft.highlight_ids = validated_highlights(draft, document)


def ifc_count(document, kind):
    elements = [e for e in document.scene.elements if e.kind == kind]
    label = "spaces (IfcSpace)" if kind == "room" else kind + "s"
    evidence = [{"element_id": e.id, "label": (e.name or e.ifc_type or e.kind)[:200],
                 "observation": f"{e.ifc_type} record #{e.source.step_id} in the uploaded IFC."} for e in elements]
    if not evidence:
        evidence = [{"element_id": None, "label": "Complete IFC catalog",
                     "observation": f"No {label} records occur in the complete imported element catalog."}]
    return DraftAnswer(status="answered", answer=f"{len(elements)} {label} are recorded in the uploaded IFC model.",
                       model_evidence=evidence, highlight_ids=[e.id for e in elements])


def ask(document, question, provider):
    start = monotonic()
    crop = None
    passes = 1
    try:
        derived = bool(document.scene and document.scene.derived)
        if derived and not document.pages:
            raise ProviderError("Original drawing pages are required to answer questions about this derived IFC. No generated dimensions were used as evidence.")
        native_ifc = document.kind == "ifc" and not derived
        gate = provider.gate(document, question)
        if gate.decision == "unclear" and not native_ifc:
            crop = provider.choose_crop(document, question)
            if crop.page not in {p.number for p in document.pages}:
                raise ProviderError("The model selected an unavailable source page for inspection. Please retry.")
            left, top, right, bottom = crop.bbox
            # A near-whole-page repeat adds no targeted inspection. Keep unclear instead.
            if (right - left) * (bottom - top) < 0.9:
                gate = provider.gate(document, question, crop)
                passes = 2
            else:
                crop = None
        kind = whole_model_count_kind(question) if native_ifc else None
        server_catalog_count = bool(kind and gate.decision == "sufficient" and document.scene.catalog_complete)
        if server_catalog_count:
            draft = ifc_count(document, kind)
        else:
            draft = provider.answer(document, question, gate, crop)
        validate_draft(draft, document, gate, server_catalog_count=server_catalog_count)
        usage = provider.usage.model_copy()
        usage.latency_ms = round((monotonic() - start) * 1000)
        payload = draft.model_dump(exclude={"calculation"})
        return Answer(**payload, inspected_pages=[p.number for p in document.pages], gate=gate,
                      inspection_passes=passes, usage=usage)
    except ProviderError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        # Deliberately do not log provider exceptions: they can contain source text or credentials.
        raise ProviderError("The selected provider could not complete the request. Check model access, quota and network, then retry. No evidence conclusion was made.") from None

    warnings = list(description.limitations)
    if not description.floors or any(not _region(f.source,pages) for f in description.floors):
        raise DocumentError("The building description needs depicted floors on available source pages.",422)
    frames = [_floor_frame(f,pages[f.source.page],warnings) for f in description.floors]
    metric = all(known for _,known,_ in frames)
    # Registration requires a common evidenced anchor AND compatible supported scales.
    aligned = metric and all(f.alignment and f.alignment.group.strip() and f.alignment.basis.strip()
        and _region(f.alignment.source,pages,f.source.page) and _point(f.alignment.anchor)
        and _inside(f.alignment.anchor,f.source.bbox) and f.rotation_degrees is not None
        and f.orientation_basis.strip() for f in description.floors)
    aligned = bool(aligned and len({f.alignment.group for f in description.floors}) == 1)
    artifact_id = str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL,"blueprintqa:"+document.id))
    builder = _Builder(artifact_id,metric)
    floors = []
    for floor_index,(floor,(matrix,known,rotation)) in enumerate(zip(description.floors,frames),start=1):
        prefix = f"floor:{floor_index}"
        page = pages[floor.source.page]
        unit = "m" if known else "relative"
        wall_height, wall_thickness, plate_thickness = (2.6,.12,.04) if known else (1.2,.08,.02)
        if aligned:
            anchor = _transform(matrix,floor.alignment.anchor)
            matrix[0][2] -= anchor[0]
            matrix[1][2] -= anchor[1]
        storey = builder.model.create_entity("IfcBuildingStorey",GlobalId=builder.guid(prefix),Name=floor.label,
            ObjectPlacement=builder.placement,CompositionType="ELEMENT",Elevation=None)
        builder.aggregate(builder.building,[storey],prefix)
        floor_source = SourceRef(kind="image",page=page.number,bbox=floor.source.bbox)
        floor_assumptions = [_assumption("elevation",0,unit,"Common display plane only; source storey elevation is unknown."),
            _assumption("layout","aligned" if aligned else "schematic",None,"Supported common anchors" if aligned else "Floor registration is unknown; separate diagrams are not a measured aligned building.")]
        if not known:
            floor_assumptions.append(_assumption("panel_extent",10,"relative","Largest source panel extent normalized to 10 display units; not a physical measurement."))
        if floor.rotation_degrees is None or not floor.orientation_basis.strip():
            floor_assumptions.append(_assumption("orientation","Original page orientation",None,"No supported orientation normalization is available."))
        if floor.order is None or not floor.order_basis.strip():
            floor_assumptions.append(_assumption("order","Source diagram order only",None,"The physical storey order is not established."))
        observations = [text for text in (floor.order_basis,floor.orientation_basis) if text]
        measurements = [m for m in floor.measurements if m.source is None or _region(m.source,pages,page.number)]
        if len(measurements) != len(floor.measurements):
            warnings.append(f"{floor.label}: measurements referencing unavailable/different source pages were omitted.")
        floors.append(SceneFloor(id=storey.GlobalId,label=floor.label,source=floor_source,
            order=floor.order if floor.order_basis.strip() else None,scale_status="known" if known else "unknown",
            rotation_degrees=rotation,alignment_status="supported" if aligned else "schematic",observations=observations,
            assumptions=floor_assumptions,calibration=floor.calibration if known else None,
            alignment=floor.alignment if aligned else None,measurements=measurements,transform=matrix))
        builder.pset(storey,PSET_NAME,{"Source":floor_source.model_dump_json(),"Floor":floors[-1].model_dump_json(),"ArtifactMarker":ARTIFACT_MARKER},prefix)
        _generate_floor(builder,floor,storey,page,matrix,known,prefix,warnings)
    if not builder.elements:
        raise DocumentError("No depicted feature entries were supplied; no model or inventory was saved.",422)
    if not any(e.Representation for e in builder.products):

    warnings.extend(["Drawing-derived visualization: generated geometry and inventory are not factual building evidence.",
        "Wall heights, thicknesses, floor plates and opening vertical dimensions are display assumptions; storey elevations are unknown."])
    if not metric:

    scene = Scene(document_id=document.id,source_kind="image",units="m" if metric else "relative",elements=builder.elements,

def _generate_floor(builder,floor,storey,page,matrix,known,prefix,warnings):
    unit="m" if known else "relative"
    wall_height,default_width,plate=(2.6,.12,.04) if known else (1.2,.08,.02)
    spaces,physical=[],[]

    def add(ifc_type,key,label,kind,semantic,source,polygon=None,z=0,height=0,assumptions=None,basis="observed",note="",reason="",environment="unknown",schematic=False):
        status="unresolved" if reason else "schematic" if schematic else "reconstructed"
        full_note=" ".join(text for text in (note,reason) if text)
        entity=builder.product(ifc_type,key,label,polygon,z,height,storey,source,assumptions or [],basis,full_note,kind,
                               representation=status,semantic_type=semantic,environment=environment)
        (spaces if ifc_type=="IfcSpace" else physical).append(entity)
        return entity

    room_polygons={i:_valid_polygon(r.polygon,floor.source.bbox) for i,r in enumerate(floor.rooms,start=1)}
    conflicts=set()
    for i,a in room_polygons.items():
        for j,b in room_polygons.items():
            if i<j and a is not None and b is not None and a.intersection(b).area>1e-12:
                conflicts.update((i,j))
    for i,room in enumerate(floor.rooms,start=1):
        source,localized=_item_source(None,room.polygon,floor,page)
        shape=room_polygons[i]
        reason="Invalid room footprint." if shape is None else "Conflicting room interiors overlap." if i in conflicts else ""
        if not localized:
            reason+=" Unlocalized: coarse floor source region only."
        world=None if reason else [_transform(matrix,p) for p in list(shape.exterior.coords)[:-1]]
        add("IfcSpace",f"{prefix}:room:{i}",room.label,"outdoor" if room.environment=="outdoor" else "room", "space",source,
            world,-plate,plate,[_assumption("floor_plate_thickness",plate,unit,"Display-only footprint plate; not a measured slab.")],
            room.basis,room.note,reason,room.environment)

    # Validate complete boundary inventory before choosing hosts, never first-match keys.
    key_counts=Counter(b.key for b in floor.boundaries)
    boundary_records={}
    for i,boundary in enumerate(floor.boundaries,start=1):
        source,localized=_item_source(boundary.source,boundary.segment,floor,page)
        expected_length=len(boundary.segment)>=2 if boundary.kind=="open_edge" else len(boundary.segment)==2
        valid=(localized and expected_length and all(_point(p) and _inside(p,source.bbox) and _inside(p,floor.source.bbox) for p in boundary.segment))
        if valid:
            edges=[tuple(sorted((tuple(a),tuple(b)))) for a,b in zip(boundary.segment,boundary.segment[1:])]
            valid=all(a!=b for a,b in edges) and len(set(edges))==len(edges)
        reason="" if valid else "Invalid boundary geometry or source association."
        if not localized:
            reason+=" Unlocalized: coarse floor source region only."
        if not boundary.key.strip() or key_counts[boundary.key]>1:
            reason="Duplicate or missing boundary key; host identity is ambiguous. "+reason
        boundary_records[i]={"description":boundary,"source":source,"reason":reason,"alias":None}
    # Exact equivalent segments can share one mesh; uncertain collinear overlaps cannot.
    for i,record in boundary_records.items():
        if record["reason"]:
            continue
        boundary=record["description"]
        for j,other in boundary_records.items():
            if i>=j or other["reason"]:
                continue
            target=other["description"]
            if LineString(boundary.segment).intersection(LineString(target.segment)).length<=0:
                continue
            equivalent=(boundary.kind==target.kind and (boundary.segment==target.segment or boundary.segment==list(reversed(target.segment)))
                        and boundary.thickness_segment==target.thickness_segment)
            if equivalent:
                # Exact duplicates have identical physical geometry; smallest key is stable.
                primary,alias=(i,j) if boundary.key<target.key else (j,i)
                boundary_records[alias]["alias"]=primary
            else:
                record.setdefault("overlap",True)
                other.setdefault("overlap",True)
    for record in boundary_records.values():
        if record.get("overlap"):
            record["reason"]="Ambiguous overlapping boundary descriptions."
    hosts={}
    generated={}
    for i,record in boundary_records.items():
        boundary=record["description"]
        source=record["source"]
        reason=record["reason"]
        alias=record["alias"]
        if alias:
            reason="Exact duplicate boundary; one shared mesh is represented by boundary "+boundary_records[alias]["description"].key+"."
        world=None
        width=default_width
        assumptions=[]
        if not reason:
            segment_points=[_transform(matrix,p) for p in boundary.segment]
            a,b=segment_points[:2]
            width_segment=boundary.thickness_segment
            observed_width=False
            if len(width_segment)==2 and all(_point(p) and _inside(p,source.bbox) and _inside(p,floor.source.bbox) for p in width_segment):
                p,q=[_transform(matrix,v) for v in width_segment]
                axis=[b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]]
                cross=[q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]]
                if (math.isclose(sum(x*y for x,y in zip(axis,cross)),0,abs_tol=1e-8) and math.dist(p,q)>0
                        and LineString([p,q]).intersects(LineString([a,b]))):
                    width=math.dist(p,q)
                    observed_width=True
            if not observed_width:
                assumptions.append(_assumption("thickness",width,unit,"Display boundary width; no usable depicted thickness segment."))
            height=wall_height if boundary.kind=="wall" else (.9 if known else .35) if boundary.kind=="railing" else plate
            if boundary.kind=="open_edge":
                width=plate
                assumptions=[_assumption("marker_width",width,unit,"Flat display marker for an open edge; not a physical wall.")]
            assumptions.append(_assumption("height",height,unit,"Display extrusion only; no source height established."))
            world=_rectangle(a,b,width)
        else:
            height=0
        ifc_type={"wall":"IfcWall","railing":"IfcRailing","open_edge":"IfcBuildingElementProxy"}[boundary.kind]
        entity=add(ifc_type,f"{prefix}:boundary:{i}",boundary.label,boundary.kind,boundary.kind,source,world,0,height,
                   assumptions,boundary.basis,boundary.note,reason,schematic=boundary.kind!="wall")
        if not reason and boundary.kind=="open_edge" and len(segment_points)>2:
            shape=entity.Representation.Representations[0]
            shape.Items=list(shape.Items)+[builder.solid_item(_rectangle(a,b,width),0,height)
                for a,b in zip(segment_points[1:],segment_points[2:])]
        generated[i]=(entity,width)
        if boundary.kind=="wall" and not reason:
            hosts[boundary.key]=(entity,boundary.segment,width)
    for i,record in boundary_records.items():
        if record["alias"] and not record["reason"]:
            primary=record["alias"]
            seen=set()
            while boundary_records[primary]["alias"] and primary not in seen:
                seen.add(primary);primary=boundary_records[primary]["alias"]
            target=boundary_records[primary]
            if not target["reason"] and target["description"].kind=="wall":
                entity,width=generated[primary]
                hosts[record["description"].key]=(entity,target["description"].segment,width)

    # Check all opening intervals before cutting any wall; conflicts have no arbitrary winner.
    opening_records={}
    for i,opening in enumerate(floor.openings,start=1):
        source,localized=_item_source(opening.source,opening.segment,floor,page)

def test_invalid_nonempty_feature_does_not_use_bbox_fallback(document):

def test_stair_graphic_is_level_symbol_not_inferred_risers_or_direction(document):

    stairs=model.by_type("IfcStairFlight")[0]
    items=list(stairs.Representation.Representations[0].Items)
    assert len(items)>1
    base,marks=items[0],items[1:]
    assert all(mark.Position.Location.Coordinates[2]==pytest.approx(base.Position.Location.Coordinates[2]+base.Depth)for mark in marks)
    assert len({mark.Depth for mark in marks})==1
    assert stairs.NumberOfRisers is None and stairs.NumberOfTreads is None
    entry=next(e for e in manifest(model).scene.elements if e.kind=="stairs")
    assumption=next(a for a in entry.assumptions if a.property=="stair_symbol")
    assert "not a source step count or rise" in assumption.reason and "No stair travel direction" in assumption.reason
    assert len(mesh(model,stairs).faces)>12

    fields = set()

    def visit(node):
        if isinstance(node, dict):
            properties = node.get("properties")
            if isinstance(properties, dict):
                fields.update(properties)
            for child in node.values():
                visit(child)
        elif isinstance(node, list):
            for child in node:
                visit(child)

    visit(BuildingDescription.model_json_schema())
    return fields


SCHEMA_FIELDS = _schema_fields()


def _validation_summary(error):
    result = []
    for item in error.errors(include_input=False, include_context=False, include_url=False):
        code = item.get("type")
        result.append({
            "type": code if code in VALIDATION_TYPES else "validation_error",
            "location": [part if type(part) is int and part >= 0 else part if type(part) is str and part in SCHEMA_FIELDS else "field"
                         for part in item.get("loc", ())],
        })
    return result


def reconstruction_error(error, phase):
    """Record only allowlisted metadata; preserve trusted application error boundaries.

    Never stringify exceptions, log tracebacks, or retain provider/Pydantic messages,
    values, contexts, request URLs, source names or response bodies.
    """
    phase = phase if phase in PHASES else "unknown"
    known = isinstance(error, (DocumentError, ProviderError))
    status = error.status if known else error.code if isinstance(error, APIError) else None
    status = status if type(status) is int and status in HTTP_STATUSES else None
    details = {}
    if known:
        category = "application_rejection" if isinstance(error, DocumentError) else "provider_failure"
        error_type = "DocumentError" if isinstance(error, DocumentError) else "ProviderError"
    elif isinstance(error, ValidationError):
        details["validation"] = _validation_summary(error)
        category = "response_json" if any(item["type"] == "json_invalid" for item in details["validation"]) else "response_schema"
        category = {"generation":"generation_failure", "artifact":"artifact_failure"}.get(phase,category)
        error_type = "ValidationError"
    elif isinstance(error, (httpx2.TimeoutException, TimeoutError)):
        category = {"generation":"generation_failure", "artifact":"artifact_failure"}.get(phase,"provider_timeout")
        error_type = "TimeoutError"
    elif isinstance(error, APIError):
        category = "provider_auth" if status in {401,403} else "provider_quota" if status == 429 else "provider_request"
        error_type = "APIError"
    else:
        category = {"provider":"provider_failure", "description":"response_schema", "generation":"generation_failure", "artifact":"artifact_failure"}.get(phase,"unexpected_failure")
        error_type = "UnexpectedError"
    diagnostic_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    event = {"event":"reconstruction_failed", "diagnostic_id":diagnostic_id, "phase":phase,
             "category":category, "error_type":error_type, **details}
    if status is not None:
        event["http_status"] = status
    try:
        LOGGER.warning("%s", json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True))
    except Exception:
        # A logging handler failure must not replace the original operational error.
        pass
    if known:
        return error
    result = ProviderError(f"{MESSAGES[category]} [{phase}/{category}; reference {diagnostic_id}]")
    result.diagnostic_id = diagnostic_id
    result.category = category
    result.phase = phase
    return result
"""Original drawing description -> deterministic IFC -> reopened/tessellated scene."""
from .building import BuildingDescription
from .documents import DocumentError
from .reconstruction_errors import reconstruction_error


def reconstruct_scene(document, page_number, provider):
    """The legacy page argument does not restrict all-source floor extraction."""
    try:
        output = provider.reconstruct(document)
    except Exception as error:
        raise reconstruction_error(error, "provider") from None
    try:
        description = BuildingDescription.model_validate(output)
        if not description.floors:
            raise DocumentError("No floor diagrams could be described confidently in the supplied pages. Source questions remain available.", 422)
    except Exception as error:
        raise reconstruction_error(error, "description") from None
    from .ifc_generate import generate_ifc
    from .ifc_artifact import load_artifact
    try:
        data = generate_ifc(description, document)
    except Exception as error:
        raise reconstruction_error(error, "generation") from None
    try:
        restored = load_artifact(data, document.id)
        if restored is None:
            raise DocumentError("The generated IFC lost its drawing provenance; no model was saved.", 422)
        scene, _, _ = restored
    except Exception as error:
        raise reconstruction_error(error, "artifact") from None
    document.ifc_bytes = data
    return scene

import json
import re

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from google.genai.errors import APIError
import httpx2
from pydantic import ValidationError
import pytest

from app.documents import DocumentError
from app.main import create_app
from app.provider import GeminiProvider, ProviderError
from app.reconstruction_errors import LOGGER, reconstruction_error
from test_backend import png
from test_ifc_generate import description


CANARY = "PRIVATE_SOURCE_SECRET_do_not_log_8f6f22"


def events(caplog):
    return [json.loads(record.getMessage()) for record in caplog.records if record.name == LOGGER.name]


def assert_safe(caplog, detail):
    assert CANARY not in detail and CANARY not in caplog.text
    for record in caplog.records:
        if record.name == LOGGER.name:
            assert record.exc_info is None and record.exc_text is None
            event = json.loads(record.getMessage())
            assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", event["diagnostic_id"])
            assert not ({"message", "input", "ctx", "url", "body", "traceback"} & event.keys())


class FakeProvider:
    def __init__(self, error=None, output=None):
        self.error, self.output, self.calls = error, output, 0

    def reconstruct(self, document):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.error:
            raise self.error
        return self.output if self.output is not None else description()

    def close(self):
        pass


def run_http_failure(tmp_path, provider, caplog):
    app = create_app(provider_factory=lambda:provider, storage_root=tmp_path)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        upload = client.post("/api/documents", files={"file":(CANARY+".png",png())}).json()
        path = f"/api/documents/{upload['document_id']}/scene"
        response = client.post(path,json={})
        assert response.status_code == 502
        assert isinstance(response.json()["detail"],str)
        assert client.get(path).status_code == 404
        assert client.get(f"/api/documents/{upload['document_id']}/model.ifc").status_code == 404
        document = app.state.documents.get(upload["document_id"])
        assert document.scene is None and document.ifc_bytes is None
    assert len(events(caplog)) == 1
    event = events(caplog)[0]
    detail = response.json()["detail"]
    assert event["diagnostic_id"] in detail and event["category"] in detail and event["phase"] in detail
    assert_safe(caplog,detail)
    return event


@pytest.mark.parametrize("code,category",[(400,"provider_request"),(401,"provider_auth"),(403,"provider_auth"),
    (429,"provider_quota"),(503,"provider_request")])
def test_real_sdk_api_error_has_only_allowlisted_status_and_safe_http_detail(tmp_path,caplog,code,category):
    error = APIError(code,{"error":{"message":CANARY,"status":CANARY,"details":[{"request":CANARY}]}})
    event = run_http_failure(tmp_path,FakeProvider(error=error),caplog)
    assert event["phase"] == "provider" and event["category"] == category
    assert event["http_status"] == code and event["error_type"] == "APIError"


def test_real_httpx2_timeout_does_not_leak_url_headers_or_message(tmp_path,caplog):
    request=httpx2.Request("POST",f"https://example.invalid/{CANARY}",headers={"Authorization":CANARY})
    event=run_http_failure(tmp_path,FakeProvider(error=httpx2.ReadTimeout(CANARY,request=request)),caplog)
    assert event["category"] == "provider_timeout" and event["error_type"] == "TimeoutError"


def test_validation_context_input_and_unknown_location_are_redacted(tmp_path,caplog):
    error=ValidationError.from_exception_data(CANARY,[{
        "type":"value_error","loc":("floors",0,"boundaries",CANARY,"source"),
        "input":{"private":CANARY},"ctx":{"error":ValueError(CANARY)},
    }])
    event=run_http_failure(tmp_path,FakeProvider(error=error),caplog)
    assert event["category"] == "response_schema"
    assert event["validation"] == [{"type":"value_error","location":["floors",0,"boundaries","field","source"]}]


def test_invalid_returned_description_has_distinct_validation_phase(tmp_path,caplog):
    event=run_http_failure(tmp_path,FakeProvider(output={"floors":CANARY,"limitations":[],CANARY:CANARY}),caplog)
    assert event["phase"] == "description" and event["category"] == "response_schema"
    assert {item["type"] for item in event["validation"]} == {"list_type","extra_forbidden"}
    assert any(item["location"] == ["field"] for item in event["validation"])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("phase",["generation","artifact"])
def test_unexpected_post_provider_failure_is_categorized_and_keeps_cache_atomic(tmp_path,caplog,monkeypatch,phase):
    def fail(*args,**kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError(CANARY)
    if phase == "generation":
        monkeypatch.setattr("app.ifc_generate.generate_ifc",fail)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr("app.ifc_generate.generate_ifc",lambda *args:b"synthetic artifact")
        monkeypatch.setattr("app.ifc_artifact.load_artifact",fail)
    event=run_http_failure(tmp_path,FakeProvider(),caplog)
    assert event["phase"] == phase and event["category"] == {"generation":"generation_failure","artifact":"artifact_failure"}[phase]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("phase",["generation","artifact"])
def test_local_validation_and_timeout_do_not_blame_provider(phase,caplog):
    error=ValidationError.from_exception_data(CANARY,[{"type":"missing","loc":(CANARY,),"input":CANARY}])
    expected={"generation":"generation_failure","artifact":"artifact_failure"}[phase]
    for cause in (error,TimeoutError(CANARY)):
        result=reconstruction_error(cause,phase)
        assert result.category==expected and events(caplog)[-1]["category"]==expected
        assert_safe(caplog,result.message)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("output",["{ malformed "+CANARY,json.dumps({"floors":CANARY,"limitations":[]})])
def test_actual_gemini_sdk_output_parsing_keeps_safe_json_vs_schema_categories(tmp_path,caplog,monkeypatch,output):
    monkeypatch.setenv("GEMINI_API_KEY","offline-only")
    provider=GeminiProvider()
    provider.client._api_client._httpx_client.close()
    def handler(request):
        return httpx2.Response(200,json={"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":output}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}]})
    provider.client._api_client._httpx_client=httpx2.Client(transport=httpx2.MockTransport(handler))
    event=run_http_failure(tmp_path,provider,caplog)
    assert event["phase"] == "provider"
    assert event["category"] == ("response_json" if output.startswith("{ malformed") else "response_schema")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("error",[
    ProviderError("Gemini reached its output token limit before completing the response. No result was accepted; try again."),
    DocumentError("Generated IFC exceeds the existing 25 MiB limit; nothing was truncated.",413),
])
def test_known_application_errors_keep_exact_message_type_and_status(error,caplog):
    original_message, original_status = error.message, error.status
    result=reconstruction_error(error,"generation")
    assert result is error and result.message==original_message and result.status==original_status
    event=events(caplog)[0]
    assert "message" not in event and event["http_status"]==original_status
    assert event["error_type"] in {"ProviderError","DocumentError"}


def test_unknown_exception_class_phase_and_http_status_are_not_logged_verbatim(caplog):
    private_type=type(CANARY,(Exception,),{})
    error=reconstruction_error(private_type(CANARY),CANARY)
    event=events(caplog)[0]
    assert event["phase"]=="unknown" and event["error_type"]=="UnexpectedError"
    assert_safe(caplog,error.message)
    caplog.clear()
    error=reconstruction_error(APIError(123456,{"message":CANARY}),"provider")
    assert "http_status" not in events(caplog)[0]
    assert_safe(caplog,error.message)


def test_logging_failure_cannot_replace_reconstruction_failure(monkeypatch):
    def fail(*args,**kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError(CANARY)
    monkeypatch.setattr(LOGGER,"warning",fail)
    error=reconstruction_error(RuntimeError(CANARY),"generation")
    assert error.category=="generation_failure" and CANARY not in error.message


def test_success_and_cached_model_remain_unchanged_without_failure_events(tmp_path,caplog):
    provider=FakeProvider()
    app=create_app(provider_factory=lambda:provider,storage_root=tmp_path)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        upload=client.post("/api/documents",files={"file":("fixture.png",png())}).json()
        path=f"/api/documents/{upload['document_id']}/scene"
        first=client.post(path,json={})
        assert first.status_code==200
        assert client.post(path,json={}).json()==first.json()
        assert client.get(f"/api/documents/{upload['document_id']}/model.ifc").status_code==200
        assert provider.calls==1
    assert events(caplog)==[]

The remaining 400 was reproduced with the current `response_json_schema` path, not the older `response_schema` path. The configured model was `gemini-flash-latest`; a successful response identified `gemini-3.8-flash`. SDK: google-genai 3.3.0. No model/provider switch or source-image edit was used.

## Controlled live evidence

The original files went through the app's existing image normalization. Their SHA-256 checksums were unchanged:

- `colorful-1794.png`: `c9547f7c5374a2a26670175fa4825c5d9dc535e8ccb7c8405a04cacbcb99b204`
- `colorful-1732.png`: `bc84828d4de3c7f602cb2355612ec1632b30297f6e07ab593a89f0448bc9b3b7`

| Probe | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Original reconstruction JSON schema, both files | HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT, generic invalid-argument message |
| Remove only `minItems`, 1794 | Same HTTP 400 |
| Remove only array `maxItems`, 1732 | Accepted, 3 room records validated locally |
| Original structured-answer schema, 1732 | HTTP 400 |
| Remove only array `maxItems`, otherwise identical answer request | Accepted, STOP, answered with one source citation |
| Relaxed reconstruction schema, 1794, original 45 s deadline | Deadline/timeout failures |
| Same 1794 request with 120 s diagnostic deadline, original 8,192-token budget | MAX_TOKENS: 7,864 reasoning tokens and 314 response tokens; incomplete JSON, rejected locally |
| Same source/schema, 16,384-token budget and 120 s deadline | STOP, 6 room records validated locally, 16.57 s in this diagnostic run |
| Larger budget/deadline, full app, default thinking | 1794 succeeded in 126.68 s; 1732 subsequently failed HTTP 502 in 118.9 s; insufficient for the demo |
| Reconstruction-only low thinking, 16,384/120 s | Both accepted: 1732 in 4.95 s, 1794 in 7.98 s |
| Low thinking, original 8,192/45 s | Both accepted and locally valid: 1732 in 7.50 s, 1794 in 5.92 s; temporary budget/deadline increases removed |

The SDK transport was instrumented without logging request bodies or credentials. The schema received by the HTTP transport matched the requested schema. For the 1732 reconstruction baseline/ablation, the serialized body excluding only `responseJsonSchema` had the identical SHA-256 `a8cb621f2276f7b6a21f435444784ef94c15b2b62119aa076050d4e7e5bf179c`. This isolates schema changes from source, prompt, model and generation settings.

These results show that the `maxItems` combination in these schemas triggers rejection on this endpoint. They do not establish that every `maxItems` constraint is unsupported or identify the server's exact internal complexity threshold. Google's [structured-output documentation](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/structured-output#simplifying-complex-schemas) explains that schema compilation can reject combinations of bounds and structure and recommends application-side validation.

## Implemented boundary

`gemini_wire_schema` removes array `maxItems` only from schema nodes, including definitions. It preserves types, required fields, enums, references, `minItems`, additional-property rules, and ordinary data/property names. Full Pydantic bounds and geometry/source validators still run after generation. OpenAI schemas, factual-answer prompts, Decisions, citation rules, refusal behavior and assumption separation are unchanged.

Only Gemini reconstruction gets `thinking_level=low`. The original 8,192-token generation budget and 45-second deadline are retained; temporary diagnostic increases were removed after low-thinking requests passed within the originals. Low thinking is a deliberate latency/geometry-quality tradeoff for approximate display geometry, not an API requirement or input limit. It may spend less effort on difficult boundaries; it does not relax local geometry validation. Factual answering, crop selection and Decisions keep their existing settings. There is no added retry or provider fallback. The configured Gemini 3.8 Flash supports this setting in its [official model documentation](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash).

`MAX_TOKENS` is an operational failure even if the returned JSON happens to parse. It is rejected before scene caching. Generic reconstruction request failures no longer tell the user to replace a supposedly poor-quality image.

Full application testing then exposed a separate local 422 on 1732: one generated 26-vertex polygon had a ring self-intersection, while the other two polygons were valid. The reconstruction prompt now explicitly asks for a simple perimeter traversed once in order, excluding furniture/cabinet/door-swing outlines. This clarifies an existing geometry requirement, not a new input restriction. A later 1794 output contained two overlapping footprints; prompt clarification alone was not sufficient.

The former all-or-nothing visualization policy now retains an explicitly partial model: invalid room footprints are omitted, and every participant in every ambiguous-overlap pair is omitted before rendering (no order-dependent winner). Surviving polygons and original room-index IDs are unchanged. Warnings visibly report the omitted count. No survivors still returns 422 without caching. Whole-response Pydantic bounds stay strict. There is no geometry repair, invented replacement, automatic retry or image edit. Omitted rooms cannot receive highlights; their original source evidence remains available to factual answering.

This policy relaxes whole-model availability, not individual geometry validity or evidence sufficiency. It can omit a usable room when its proposed footprint conflicts with another; the incompleteness warning and source-only answers make that limitation explicit. Generated room counts remain nonfactual.

The existing room/vertex/list limits remain local design choices, not Gemini requirements. This fix neither lowers them nor silently accepts over-limit output. Existing source-reference, bounds, polygon and calculation checks remain unchanged; semantic correctness is not guaranteed.

## Regression checks

New tests exercise actual SDK request serialization/transport and assert that local bounds remain enforced, truncated outputs are rejected, and reconstruction's low-thinking setting does not leak into answer/crop/gate calls. These mocked checks supplement the controlled live tests above; they do not establish API compatibility by themselves.

## Application endpoint verification

The final smoke run uses the real Gemini provider through FastAPI TestClient: multipart upload, POST scene, cached scene reuse, POST question with the actual Decisions gate, and GET scene comparison. It is not a mocked inference run.

Final production-code run completed successfully on both unchanged files:

| Image | POST scene | Supported source question | Missing actual ceiling height |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| colorful-1794.png | 200, 6 approximate room objects, 12.20 s | 200, sufficient/answered, 1 citation, 1 validated highlight, 12.29 s | 200, insufficient, 0 highlights, 7.68 s |
| colorful-1732.png | 200, 3 approximate room objects, 15.38 s | 200, sufficient/answered, 1 citation, 1 validated highlight, 7.97 s | 200, insufficient, 0 highlights, 6.45 s |

The real Gemini crop request on 1732 also returned a locally valid CropRequest. Both source checksums remained unchanged. Repeated scene POST/GET calls returned identical cached geometry after answering. These are integration checks, not a general accuracy benchmark. No ground-truth question files were used as runtime context.

Final regression suite: **119 passed, 7 optional browser tests skipped**. Independent final review: **68 focused tests passed**, no code blockers. The new filtering tests verify exact surviving geometry/source references, original-index IDs, omitted highlights, containment and overlap chains, visible warnings, caching, and zero-survivor rejection.

Diagnostic full-app run before low thinking: 1794 returned HTTP 200 with six unscaled room objects (126.68 s), a cited/highlighted answer (8.62 s), and height refusal (9.35 s), but 1732 failed after 118.9 s. This was not accepted as completion. The final low-thinking endpoint run is recorded below.

Room footprints varied between generations. Runtime success and structural validation are not a measurement of footprint accuracy; generated geometry remains approximate and must never supply factual room counts or dimensions. Cached scenes avoid changing geometry between questions.
# Agent handoff — 2026-11-14, reconstruction V3

## Status

V3 implements explicit physical boundaries, real wall-hosted openings, indoor/outdoor spaces, schematic stairs/furnishings/fixtures, persistent unresolved records and an original-page comparison of actual reopened IFC geometry. **Full visual fidelity acceptance is not yet met.** Live source comparisons still find omitted/misplaced features; do not confuse passing API, IFC or browser checks with complete reconstruction.

Read [RECONSTRUCTION_V3_PLAN.md](RECONSTRUCTION_V3_PLAN.md), [RECONSTRUCTION_V3_CONTRACT.md](RECONSTRUCTION_V3_CONTRACT.md) and [RECONSTRUCTION_V3_DIAGNOSIS.md](RECONSTRUCTION_V3_DIAGNOSIS.md). V2 verification is historical. No commits, pushes, deployment, new dependencies or services.

## Run and inspect

Run `bash scripts/dev.sh`; open http://127.0.0.1:8000. Upload unchanged `assets/junction-dataset/data/cubicasa5k/colorful-11397.png` or `colorful-1794.png`, then Generate building model. In Drawing view enable Source comparison and toggle spaces/walls/openings/features/unresolved layers. These paths come from actual tessellated IFC meshes, inverse-transformed into the original page, not copied model description polygons. Walls use a section through assumed opening heights; other objects use footprint projection. Inspect missing features, incorrect enclosure and misplaced openings against the original.

The inventory links all interpreted entries to source evidence and exposes unresolved reasons. It does not certify complete coverage. Model view keeps orbit, floor filters, schematic separation, answer highlighting, 10% surrounding opacity, independent assumptions and source clicks. Download/reupload preserves source pages, exact V3 input description, stable IDs, statuses and assumptions. V2 artifacts still reopen.

## Provider configuration

Gemini is the default/final demo provider. Reconstruction alone makes one high-thinking `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` request; override explicitly with `GEMINI_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL`. Its 150-second timeout and 32,768-output-token budget are design choices measured against the richer inventory; large drawings can still exceed them. Truncated output is an operational error and cannot be cached. There is no automatic fallback or refinement stage.

`GEMINI_MODEL` remains the source-answer model (locally `gemini-flash-latest`); native Decisions, answer/crop budgets and refusal flow are unchanged. `.env.local` and credentials were not edited. `AI_PROVIDER=openai` remains an explicit temporary adapter with equivalent description fields and reconstruction-only time/token budgets. OpenAI V3 is SDK/regression tested, not live-fidelity verified. Health reports the reconstruction model separately.

## Geometry and provenance rules

- Room polygons make floor plates only. Explicit walls/shared boundaries are independent of rooms; invalid rooms cannot suppress valid walls/openings/features. Door leaves, swing arcs and furnishing outlines never automatically create walls.
- Door/window records name an explicit same-floor wall key. Valid gaps create actual IFC void/fill relationships. Invalid/ambiguous hosts stay unresolved, retaining source, stable ID and reason; no nearest-wall attachment.
- Outdoor space footprints do not imply enclosure. Open-edge polylines make flat markers; railings require explicit depicted support. No inferred hidden floors.
- Stairs/furniture/fixtures may be flat schematics when vertical shape is unknown. Stair marks are level symbols, not measured treads/rise or travel direction. Empty feature polygons request an explicit bbox schematic; malformed supplied geometry stays unresolved.
- V3 source boxes may provide context beyond the approximate floor bbox if the same-page regions overlap. Geometry anchors must remain in both floor and source region. Wrong-page/disjoint sources do not acquire invented geometry. V2 keeps its former containment validation.
- Unknown scale is `UNSCALED_DISPLAY_UNIT`, never measured metres. Supported calibration affects plan scale only. All missing vertical dimensions, opening heights/sills, symbol thicknesses and layout offsets remain assumptions.
- Generated IFC always reopens as derived drawing visualization, never as a factual native IFC catalog. Original embedded PNGs are validated by hash/dimensions; manifest, IFC properties, classes and storeys must agree. Original source QA excludes generated properties, geometry and assumed heights. The object index is only a fallible association aid. Unknown/ambiguous source associations retain citations without highlights.
- Every described item survives as reconstructed/schematic/unresolved. The model can still omit a source item completely: a valid inventory does not prove “everything shown” was found. All-unresolved scenes clearly report no 3D geometry and keep source inspection available.

## Verification and known blockers

The final live report and actual IFC/source overlays are recorded in [RECONSTRUCTION_V3_DIAGNOSIS.md](RECONSTRUCTION_V3_DIAGNOSIS.md). Temporary artifacts/scripts are under `/tmp/junction-v3/`; `/final/` contains the final1794 production-path run and the initial rejected11397 request; `/diagnostic/` contains the exact-request successful11397 repeat and latest model; `/pro/` is an earlier controlled model comparison. Do not mix their descriptions or screenshots. No reference answer files were used.

- 194 backend/native-IFC tests passed; all 11 optional Chromium checks passed separately. Doctor passes. Native sample: `assets/junction-dataset/data/ifc_bench/duplex_arc.ifc`.
- Regression coverage includes room/wall independence, outdoor non-enclosure, true hosted gaps, duplicate/conflicting hosts, semantic feature classes, unresolved persistence, V2/V3 provenance and fresh-store reopening, source-only QA, conservative highlights and independent assumptions. A test moves actual IFC placement while holding provenance fixed and confirms the comparison moves.
- Independent read-only code review passed 106 focused checks with no code blockers. Independent visual review reports unresolved acceptance blockers because real extraction results still have fidelity errors. The latest successful two-floor IFC passed real Gemini browser QA, source clicking, orbit, highlight fading and actual-height refusal after reopening; those do not establish complete source fidelity.
